# CLAP headers, pinned

The CLever Audio Plugin API headers from https://github.com/free-audio/clap,
release **1.2.10**, unmodified, under the MIT licence in `LICENSE`.

Source archive: `clap-1.2.10.tar.gz` (GitHub release tag `1.2.10`),
SHA-256 `58fdb977c6678859c15d57942378b651399178f49a3a8ecad1813b9f231dc096`.
Only `include/clap` is kept; nothing else from the archive is used.
